description: Official source registry for the Russia-only AA meeting directory (issue #316). Navigation/reference data plane, separate from the canonical book corpus. Public display on these sites is not a redistribution license; see reuse_policy and permission_status per source.
reuse_policy: No bulk republication. Snapshot stores only minimal manually reviewed factual pointers (public group names, public venues, official navigation URLs, published timetables with provenance) plus official directory links. No entry codes, private credentials, personal identities, contacts, or raw scraped pages are stored. Inaccessible or uncertain robots/terms are recorded as unknown, never as permission.
